roles.name: Admin

roles.description: Directs lead distribution, deal pipelines, and CRM performance

roles.name: Sales Representative
roles.description: Handles assigned outbound campaigns, lead enrichment, and booked introductions

roles.name: Marketing
roles.description: Designs sequences and builds incoming lead campaign structures
